activity.notes: The game/mod label 'Pati Djaja Raja' corresponds to Tumenggung Surapati, also styled Kiai Dipati Jaya Raja / Pangeran Dipati in local traditions. He was a Dayak leader in the Dusun Ulu–Murung–Siang sphere and became an important resistance commander allied with Pangeran Antasari during the Banjar/Barito resistance from 1859 until his death in 1875. ATLAS does not create a fictional 'Dayak Empire'.
